names.en: Ten Extreme Immortal Zombie Lifeless Formation

summary.text: The ten extreme immortal zombie lifeless formation is Shadow Sect's Gu formation at Yi Tian Mountain. Ten immortal zombies stand as cores while souls merge into the array.

claims.text: Old Man Yan Shi tells Wu Xie that the ten extreme immortal zombie lifeless formation they set has already entrapped nearby Southern Border Gu Immortals, though only a small portion is set and it cannot display one-tenth of its might while tribulations wear it down. After he and other Shadow Sect Gu Immortals sacrifice their souls into the formation, it reaches ninety percent and a vast radiance soars to the sky. When the radiance passes, a gigantic Gu formation covers the area. Ten Gu Immortals stand in the air at the outermost periphery encircling the Southern Border group: nine in black robes with hoods covering their appearances, and the young Gu Immortal Ying Wu Xie. The formation that had swayed under tribulations now stands firm like a mountain reef.

Fang Yuan’s gaze falls on the formation through the cloud layer and his breathing turns rough as he doubts even Fixed Immortal Travel against it. The formation then sends an incomparably swift attack at Jia Yi.

Shadow Sect appears early and arranges the ten extreme immortal zombie lifeless formation successfully, so Fixed Immortal Travel is ineffective inside it. Even Immortal Gu House Graceful Chaotic Duel Stage would take time to break through the ninety percent complete formation. The formation spreads to ten thousand li around Yi Tian Mountain, isolating space and stopping sound transmissions.
